passenger_response.subject: Your cancellation claim – booking AER-9L5D2R
passenger_response.body:
Dear Marta Kowalczyk,

Our record shows that flight AK808 on 2026-08-03 was cancelled because of WEATHER: freezing fog at EDI, with RVR below operating minima from 17:20 to 23:00 local. The crew were on stand and within hours at the time of cancellation. This differs from your account that the cause was crew-related.

The recorded great-circle distance was 665 km, placing the flight in Band A. Because the recorded cause was weather, an extraordinary circumstance, no compensation is payable. The conclusion also relies on the arrival delay at the final destination being recorded as None minutes.

We have not repaid what you spent. Costs you paid yourself are reimbursed against your receipts, and that has to be handled by a colleague rather than at this desk. Keep the receipts.

We have paid what the policy entitles you to. Anything beyond that is discretionary and is not ours to decide at this desk, so it has been passed on. Please do not read that as agreement that a further payment is due.

You and our record do not agree on why the flight was disrupted. We have to work from the record, and we have set out what it says. The difference has been passed to the team that can review it.

Your duty of care was unaffected by the cause of the cancellation. This includes meals and refreshments up to £30 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to £180 per room per night for a maximum of 3 nights subject to station allocation, and transport up to £45 per journey.

Kind regards
